keyGuidelines.title: ICMR-NIN Targets (OVERWEIGHT Profile - 2120 kcal/day)
keyGuidelines.description: Aligned with Government of India ICMR-NIN standards for maternal health in Karnataka. Raw group targets: Cereals & Millets (250g), Pulses & Legumes (60g), Green Leafy Vegetables (150g), Seasonal Vegetables (200g).

keyGuidelines.title: 🥛 Lacto-Vegetarian Protein & Probiotic Harmony
keyGuidelines.description: Synergize legumes, dals, and millets with fresh dairy (curd, buttermilk, paneer) to achieve complete amino acid profiles and bioavailable calcium. Homemade curd supports gut microbiota and eases digestive heartburn.
foodsToAvoid: Packaged flavored yogurts with high sugar

keyGuidelines.title: 🌾 Millet Synergy for Sustained Glycemic Control
keyGuidelines.description: Traditional Karnataka millets (Ragi, Jolada, Sajje) have low glycemic indices and abundant soluble fiber, releasing glucose gradually into the bloodstream to safeguard against gestational insulin resistance.
foodsToAvoid: Polished white rice in large single portions

keyGuidelines.title: 🚨 ICMR Iron & Vitamin C Absorption Protocol
keyGuidelines.description: Combine iron-rich plant foods (Basale, Drumstick greens, Sprouted Moong, Poha) with Vitamin C fruits (Amla, Guava, Orange, Lemon). Never drink tea or coffee within 1 hour of meals, as tannins inhibit iron absorption by up to 60%.
foodsToAvoid: Tea or coffee consumed immediately with or after meals

keyGuidelines.title: ⚠️ Gestational Diabetes Glycemic Regulation
keyGuidelines.description: Maintain 5–6 small, frequent meals rather than 2 large meals to prevent postprandial glucose excursions. Emphasize low glycemic index millets and fiber-rich greens.

chatHistories.content: Namaste Priya! I am your Matern Health Companion. I can provide evidence-based educational guidance regarding gestational diabetes, prenatal nutrition, cervical screening, and your test results. What would you like to explore today?

directMessages.content: Namaste Dr. Ananya, my 2-hour post-meal blood sugar came out to 138 mg/dL today after lunch. I felt slightly dizzy around 3 PM. Should I modify my dinner plan?

Hello Priya. A reading of 138 mg/dL is slightly above our optimal prenatal ceiling of 120-130 mg/dL, which explains the mild sluggishness. Please replace any refined grain with ragi or bajra roti for dinner, take a gentle 15-minute post-meal stroll, and check your fasting glucose tomorrow at 7:30 AM. If you notice visual flashes or headache, contact our triage immediately.
Understood Doctor! I followed the low-GI dinner plan and took a 20-minute walk. Fasting sugar this morning was 92 mg/dL. Also set my daily supplement reminder for 09:00 AM. Thank you!
Excellent progress, Priya! 92 mg/dL fasting is right in our target zone (<95 mg/dL). Keep up the steady hydration and supplement adherence. See you for the scheduled 26-week scan on Thursday.
Doctor, I received my Pap smear report showing LSIL and positive HPV 16. I am feeling very anxious about what this means for cancer risk. What are the next steps?

Sunita, please take a deep breath. Having positive HPV with LSIL indicates early surface cellular changes, NOT cancer. The majority of these changes are reversible or easily managed when detected early. I have scheduled a colposcopy review for you next Tuesday where we will examine the cervical surface under magnification. Please avoid douching or intercourse 48 hours prior.

patientMedications.instructions: Take with citrus juice or water after breakfast. Avoid tea, coffee, or milk for 2 hours.
